name: New 3-lane link Ngã Tư Sở – Kim Liên (straight line)
description: Adds a one-way 3-lane primary road from Ngã Tư Sở straight to the Kim Liên junction. Note: the new road arrives at a signalised junction as an extra east-west approach, so default green splits shift away from Lê Duẩn - in this model the new road can make things worse (try editing the signal at node 2147).
